description: This Java class defines a custom file filter for use with Swing JFileChooser components, specifically filtering for XML files with the extension '.xml'. It manages a list of extensions, provides description strings, and determines whether files are accepted based on their extensions or directory status.

classes.name: XMLFilter
classes.description: A custom Swing file filter for accepting XML files, optionally displaying extensions in descriptions.

methods.name: XMLFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the filter with an XML extension and default description.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Determines if a file is accepted based on being a directory or having the '.xml' extension.

methods.name: getExtension
methods.description: Returns the file extension in lowercase for a given File object.

methods.name: addExtension
methods.description: Adds a file extension to the filter's list of accepted extensions.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string, optionally including all filtered extensions.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the textual description for this file filter.

methods.name: setExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Configures whether to include the list of extensions in the description.

methods.name: isExtensionListInDescription
methods.description: Returns whether the extension list is included in the description.
